title: Night Cream for Dry Skin in Winter: A Simple Routine
ex: Cold air, heaters and hot baths dry skin out. Here is what to look for in a winter night cream and a routine that helps skin feel soft by morning.
rt: Night Cream for Dry Skin in Winter | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream for dry skin in winter: what to look for, a simple bedtime routine and small habits that help skin feel soft through cold, dry Indian winters.
keyword: night cream for dry skin in winter
quick: Choose a richer night cream with nourishing oils like avocado and water-holding aloe vera. Apply it on slightly damp skin after a lukewarm wash, add a thin second layer on dry patches, and keep using sunscreen in the morning, as the winter sun in India is still strong.
facts: Apply cream on slightly damp skin
Lukewarm water is kinder than hot water
Add a second thin layer on dry patches
Sunscreen is still needed in winter
